claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Perhexiline at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, since its known toxicity (hepatotoxicity, mitochondrial beta-oxidation/oxidative phosphorylation inhibition) requires chronic dosing and hepatic metabolism rather than direct cytotoxicity at low micromolar concentrations.
